items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Isolate the circuit breaker for the motor of this pump.

The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing suction and 
 delivery valves.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, suitable lifting device.
Manual puller, feeler gauges.
Check the direction of rotation of pump and driver.

Check the oil level in gearbox or fill it to the maximum 
 height with the recommended grade of lubricating oil.

Check that the mechanical seal circulation pipe (if fitted) 
 is clear and not blocked.

Check that if the suction and discharge pipes have been 
 secured to the pump no strain has been imposed it must be possible to turn 
 the coupling by hand without feeling tight spot.

Check that suction pipe flange joint is air light the 
 entrainment of air must be avoided.
Check the temperature of bearing houses.
Check any noise or vibration in pump.
Check any leakage from the piping connection to the pump.
Check the pressure in the pump delivery.
Check the alignment between pump and motor.
Retighten all bolts connected pump and motor with foundation.

Return back all mechanical and electrical pump positions to the normal by 
 coordinating with shift engineer
Operate the pump and ensure that it is OK and record the readings.

Operate the pump by coordination 
 with the shift engineer.

Ensure that the pump is OK and check the 
 direction of rotation, record the 
 readings of pressure, temp., vibration, according to the technical 
 specification table at introduction, and compare with the previous reading.

Introduction
This document out lines the equipment 
Inspection I1, 
which must be performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block
This pump is used for transfer Mazout from heater H.P Mazout to burners.
The first draft initiated by 
eng. Abd El Naeem Attalla, reviewed by maintenance director eng. Mohamed El Amshety 
& by General Director Abd El Shafy Ali, revised by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Samir

and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al-lethy Head sector of EDEPCo. Inspection &

Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance

A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Isolate the circuit breaker for the motor of this pump.
The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing suction and 
 delivery valves.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, suitable lifting device.
Manual puller, feeler gauges.
Work to be Carried Out
Check the direction of rotation of pump and driver.
Check the oil level in gearbox or fill it to the maximum 
 height with the recommended grade of lubricating oil.
Check that the mechanical seal circulation pipe (if fitted) 
 is clear and not blocked.
Check that if the suction and discharge pipes have been 
 secured to the pump no strain has been imposed it must be possible to turn 
 the coupling by hand without feeling tight spot.
Check that suction pipe flange joint is air light the 
 entrainment of air must be avoided.
Check the temperature of bearing houses.
Check any noise or vibration in pump.
Check any leakage from the piping connection to the pump.
Check the pressure in the pump delivery.
Check the alignment between pump and motor.
Retighten all bolts connected pump and motor with foundation.
Return back all mechanical and electrical pump positions to the normal by 
 coordinating with shift engineer
Operate the pump and ensure that it is OK and record the readings.
Operation of the Pump
Operate the pump by coordination 
 with the shift engineer.
Ensure that the pump is OK and check the 
 direction of rotation, record the 
 readings of pressure, temp., vibration, according to the technical 
 specification table at introduction, and compare with the previous reading.

Trouble 
Shooting
Trouble | Possible | Remedy
Pump does not apply amount | Suction line trouble | Check suction valve it must be opened.
 Check air tightness of suction piping.
Pump not primed | Prime the pump
Opposite sense of rotation | Check the rotation direction
Leakage in relief valve | Check the relief valve seat and also its spring
Excessive suction lift | Check the recommended specification
Excessive worn in rotating pistons and pump casing | Change the rotation piston and repair pump casing or 
 changed it
Delivered amount is low | Suction line trouble | Check suction valve and it must be opened
 Check air tightness of suction piping
Pump speed are too low | Check the recommended specification
Clearance between rotating pistons bore or covers is too 
 great | Change the worn parts
Mechanical impurities in the liquid | Check the filter before pump
Pump does not catch the prescribed 
 pressure | Pressure gauge gives low pressure | Recalibrate the pressure gauge or renewed it
Clearance between the rotating pistons, body and covers 
 is too great | Check or change worn parts of pump
Direct connection of suction with delivery happened in 
 the pump | Dismantle the pump and check it
Excessive noise in pump | Air in pump casing | Check air-tightness of pump casing
Misalignment | Realignment the pump with motor and retighten all bolts 
 of pump and motor with foundation.
Dishrag pressure too high | Check the recommended dishrag pressure
Bearing damage | Change the bearing
Excessive power consumption | Excessive dishrag pressure | Check the pressure gauge
Uncorrected assembly of pump | Mount the pump correctly
Cold liquid or high 
 viscosity | Measure the viscosity and temperature
Gland is tightening too much and heated | Check the mechanical seal and it must be leakage some 
 drops of liquid to cooling gland
Bearing damage | Check the bearing and exchanged it if needed
Pump speed higher than rated | Measure the pump speed
